record.text:
🏀 Memphis Grizzlies win!

MEM 118
TOR 102

Cameron Boozer: 22 pts, 8 reb, 8 ast
Jamal Shead: 20 pts, 2 reb, 11 ast

#NBA #Raptors #Grizzlies

All it took was getting rid of Ja, drafting Cam Boozer, adding Ty Jerome and Memphis is back to being the try-hard Grizzlies.

Officially the “oh crap we gotta play those guys tomorrow” team of 2026/27.

Not a terrible effort (for most of the night) but margin for error is basically 0 when you're missing 4 of your top-6 scorers (including your 3 best defenders) and RJ has 1 of his worst games of the year. Too much to overcome vs a good/deep Grizzlies team. Raptors (5-5) back to .500
The Grizzlies are still on fire shooting. Down 12 with under 6 minutes left, I think that will need change for any chance of winning
